objects.subject: hurricane_pike
objects.quote: Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
objects.reason_zh: 可对自己施放，沿面朝方向连续推动一段距离。

objects.subject: overwhelming_blink
objects.quote: Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

objects.subject: swift_blink
objects.quote: Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away. After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed
objects.reason_zh: 可传送并获得限时移速加成，但材料未解释相位移动是否另有移动方式变化。

objects.subject: tpscroll
objects.quote: After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.
objects.reason_zh: 持续施法后传送到友方建筑。

objects.subject: travel_boots
objects.quote: Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.; + 90 Movement Speed
objects.reason_zh: 通过升级回城卷轴提供以单位为目标的传送，并增加移动速度。

objects.subject: wind_waker
objects.quote: When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.; + 30 Movement Speed
objects.reason_zh: 对自己施放后可在旋风状态下自由移动，装备属性还提供移速加成。
